title: Lower: Front Squat + Pull
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: KOT Sissy Squat × 8 · Wall Shoulder CAR × 3/side · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Front Squat 1 @ RPE 7 → Hurdle Hops 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
Side to side over a line
strength: Rest 3:00 · heaviest week of the block · elbows high
Band or Banded Lat Pulldown to scale

cond.subtitle: Cap 15 min
items: Cal Assault bike (or 2× the reps as walking lunge steps)

note: Heaviest week of the block. Strength block starts Nov 16.
